primitives.name: Button
primitives.description: Baseline command primitive with six variants, sm/md/lg/icon sizes, and normal/loading/disabled states.
notes: Apps should replace token values and variant naming only when their design system requires it; do not recreate one-off buttons per screen.
implementationHints: The debug variant is the ring-debug DebugButton: ink fill, 10pt radius, 13pt semibold white label, 48pt minimum height; disabled 0.35.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A native keyboard-reachable button whose visible label supplies its accessible name; the icon size keeps the label as visually hidden text.

stateSets.name: Size States
stateSets.description: Control heights, including a square icon-only size.

states.name: Icon
implementationHints: Keep a text label for the accessible name when rendering icon-only.

states.name: Hover
implementationHints: Apply on pointer hover only; touch platforms skip it.

states.name: Focus
implementationHints: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible), not on pointer press.

states.name: Loading
implementationHints: Expose busy state to accessibility APIs.

states.name: Disabled
implementationHints: Prevent interaction and expose disabled state.

primitives.name: Input
primitives.description: Text input primitive with visual variants and validation states.
notes: Input states are a core app behavior and should not be inferred from a single rendered form.
implementationHints: Preserve empty, value, focused, invalid, and disabled states in target code.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A native text input with a programmatically associated label and a visible focus ring.

primitives.name: Checkbox
primitives.description: Binary selection primitive.
implementationHints: Expose checked and disabled states explicitly.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A keyboard-reachable binary selection control whose checked and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.

states.name: Focus
implementationHints: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: Switch
primitives.description: Binary toggle primitive.
implementationHints: Keep touch target larger than the visual thumb where needed.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A binary toggle exposing its on/off state with an associated visible label and an explicit disabled presentation.

states.name: Focus
implementationHints: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: OTP Input
primitives.description: Fixed-cell verification input primitive.
implementationHints: Model cell count and focus behavior explicitly.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A fixed-length passcode input announced as one field with a visible focus cell and caret.

primitives.name: Slider
primitives.description: Continuous range control primitive.
implementationHints: Keep track, fill, thumb, disabled, and contrast variants separate.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A range control exposing its value, minimum, and maximum with a keyboard-operable thumb.

primitives.name: Surface
primitives.description: Sequential surface ladder: each nested surface, card, grouped list, or pressable row sits one level deeper than its parent.
notes: Roots marked data-blueprint-surface take the level after their nearest marked ancestor; a surface state sets an explicit level for its subtree.
implementationHints: Carry the parent surface level through context so nested cards, lists, and rows render one level deeper.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A non-interactive container level; nested content keeps its own semantics and reachability.

stateSets.name: Surface Levels
stateSets.description: Explicit surface levels 1 through 5; nested surfaces step one level deeper.

primitives.name: Card
primitives.description: GlassCard (@kore/ui): frosted glass container. Screens apply the same prototype/styles/glass.css classes (glass, glass--<tint>, glass--r<radius>) to cards that hold other reusables.
implementationHints: Radius 34 default; screens use 28 (hero/detail), 26 (paired/legend), 24 (metric tiles), 22 (stat tiles). Padding is per card (13–24).
Pressable cards scale to 0.975 over 160ms and carry a Chevron at top 22/right 18 unless offset.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A neutral content container; interactive children remain individually reachable.

primitives.name: Navigation Bar
primitives.description: Balanced slot navigation primitive.
implementationHints: Keep side slots balanced so titles remain centered.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A navigation landmark with a centered title and accessibly named slot actions.

stateSets.name: Slot States
stateSets.description: Left, center, and right slot compositions.

primitives.name: Back Button
primitives.description: BackButton (@kore/ui): 32pt GlassCircle with a slate left chevron.
implementationHints: Keep icon-only controls accessible.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: An icon-only button whose accessible name comes from its aria label.

primitives.name: Separator
primitives.description: Divider primitive.
implementationHints: Tie divider emphasis to surface nesting level.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A thematic break exposed as a separator to assistive technology.

primitives.name: List
primitives.description: Grouped list primitive.
implementationHints: Use list for grouped rows and dividers.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A list of rows exposed with list and listitem semantics.

primitives.name: Pressable Row
primitives.description: Row-shaped pressable primitive.
implementationHints: Keep row-shaped press behavior separate from list grouping.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A single keyboard-reachable row-shaped button with a text-backed accessible name.

primitives.name: Row Layout
primitives.description: Leading/body/trailing slot layout primitive without a surface.
implementationHints: Use when a row owns layout but not surface or press behavior.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A purely presentational leading/body/trailing row; only interactive slot content receives focus.

primitives.name: Loading Mark
primitives.description: ActivityIndicator stand-in; mint and indigo tones match the pairing screen spinners.
notes: This generalizes the reference mark into a replaceable app-owned loader.
implementationHints: Replace geometry with the app mark if one exists; keep tone states.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A polite status indicator that announces busy state without trapping focus.

primitives.name: Badge
primitives.description: Pill (@kore/ui Pill): sentence-case status and action chip with per-metric tints (deep-tone text for 4.5:1) and a solid ink selection.
implementationHints: Sizes encode the Pill paddingH/em combinations screens use: md 12/.14, status 12/.18, action 12/.16, tight 8/.06, count 10/.14, unit 12/.10, about 12/.08.
Interactive pills extend their hit area to 48×48 with hitSlop 14; pressed dims to 0.7.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A compact status label whose visible text supplies the meaning; tone is never color-only.

primitives.name: Icon
primitives.description: Icon wrapper primitive.
implementationHints: Keep icon sizing and stroke width tokenized.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A decorative inline glyph wrapper; the host supplies any accessible naming through surrounding text.

primitives.name: Skeleton
primitives.description: Loading placeholder primitive.
implementationHints: Tie skeleton fill to the current surface level.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A decorative loading placeholder hidden from assistive technology while content loads.

primitives.name: Alert Dialog
primitives.description: Modal confirmation primitive.
implementationHints: Keep destructive intent on the action, not the whole panel.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A modal alert dialog named by its title, described by its message, and keeping destructive intent on the confirm action only.

primitives.name: Context Menu
primitives.description: Floating action menu primitive.
implementationHints: Model item, inset item, separator, shortcut, and destructive item roles.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A menu of keyboard-navigable items with separator, shortcut, checked, and destructive item roles.

primitives.name: Bottom Sheet
primitives.description: Sheet primitive composed from handle, navbar, body, and footer slots.
implementationHints: Keep sheet navbar, content, and footer slots independently targetable.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A modal sheet region whose handle, navigation, content, and footer keep a logical source order.

primitives.name: Text
primitives.description: Canonical type-ramp primitive binding the typography tokens to semantic text tones.
notes: Use the ramp roles instead of one-off font styles; screens may still set screen-local display treatments.
implementationHints: Map variants to the app's text component roles and keep tones semantic.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Readable text whose tone never relies on color alone for meaning.

primitives.name: Radio
primitives.description: Single-choice selection primitive.
implementationHints: Expose selected and disabled states explicitly and group radios with one name.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A keyboard-reachable single-choice control whose selected and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.

states.name: Focus
implementationHints: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: Select
primitives.description: Single-value dropdown field primitive with placeholder, value, open, and disabled states.
implementationHints: Keep the listbox in the primitive; map options from the target app's data.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A named, keyboard-reachable listbox control whose value and expanded state are exposed to assistive technology.

primitives.name: Tabs
primitives.description: In-screen section switch primitive with a selected tab and a disabled tab.
implementationHints: Keep one tablist per section set; expose the selected tab to assistive technology.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A tablist whose selected tab and disabled tabs are exposed to assistive technology.

primitives.name: Toast
primitives.description: Transient feedback panel primitive with semantic tones and a quiet action.
implementationHints: Announce toasts through a live region and keep them transient.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A status message announced through a live region whose tone is not conveyed by color alone.

primitives.name: Textarea
primitives.description: Multi-line text field with label, hint, and validation states.
implementationHints: Map to the target platform multi-line text field and keep the visible label as its accessible name.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A labelled native textarea whose hint text describes the field.

primitives.name: Avatar
primitives.description: Person or entity mark with initials, fallback glyph, and presence status.
implementationHints: Map to the target avatar component; replace initials with a controlled image asset when one exists.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: An image-role mark whose accessible name is the person or entity name.

primitives.name: Progress
primitives.description: Progress bar; Kore variants are the head-less ProgressBar (6pt pill track with gradient fill set by --value 0–1).
implementationHints: Expose progress through the platform progress API with the visible label as its name.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A progressbar with a visible label and current value.

primitives.name: Tooltip
primitives.description: Short inverse label anchored to a control.
implementationHints: Show on hover and keyboard focus; never put required information only in a tooltip.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A tooltip role describing its anchor control.

stateSets.name: Placement States
stateSets.description: Which side of the anchor the tooltip sits on.

primitives.name: Inline Alert
primitives.description: Persistent in-flow message with a tone, title, and message.
implementationHints: Use role="alert" only for urgent messages that must interrupt assistive technology.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A status message whose title and message are read together.

primitives.name: Segmented Control
primitives.description: RangeSelector (@kore/ui): capsule track with a sliding ink capsule for Day/Week/Month.
implementationHints: Map to the target segmented control; use tabs instead when options switch whole panels.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A radiogroup whose options are radios named by their visible labels.

primitives.name: Table Row
primitives.description: Data table row with primary, text, numeric, and status cells.
implementationHints: Map to the target data table row and keep numeric columns end-aligned with tabular figures.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A table row of cells inside a table or grid.

primitives.name: Label
primitives.description: Sentence-case caption (@kore/ui Label) used for card titles, dates, status, and axis text; 13pt/500 by default, 11pt minimum for axis and timestamps.
implementationHints: Label(size, em, color) in packages/ui/src/components/Typo.tsx — variants map the size/em/color combinations screens use.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Plain text in natural sentence casing.

primitives.name: Icon Badge
primitives.description: Rounded gradient chip with a MaterialCommunityIcons glyph that marks each card's function (@kore/ui IconBadge).
implementationHints: Glyph slot takes a MaterialCommunityIcons outline (24-unit SVG). The inherit variant reads --icon-tint-* from an ancestor .icon-tint-<hue> class so components can re-tint it.
Border radius is size × 0.36 and glyph size is round(size × 0.58), as in IconBadge.tsx.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative; the adjacent label carries meaning.

primitives.name: Glass Circle
primitives.description: Frosted circular control (@kore/ui GlassCircle) for header sync/ring actions and the Trends link.
implementationHints: Active = glyph in mint (busy sync, or ring synced before). The home header stacks a Label (tiny) under each circle as one 48×48 target.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: A button named by its aria label; the glyph is decorative.

primitives.name: Chevron
primitives.description: Border-drawn chevron (@kore/ui Chevron) marking pressable cards and the back button.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative affordance only.

primitives.name: Score Ring
primitives.description: Gradient progress ring with a centered score (@kore/ui ScoreRing), drawn from -90° with a round cap over a neutral track.
implementationHints: Set the arc with a --score custom property (0–100) on the use class; values under 2 clamp to 2 like ScoreRing.tsx (fraction min 0.02).
Sizes: hero 172/10 (home readiness), lg 170/10 (readiness screen), md 118/8 (activity), sm 92/8 (sleep and activity cards).
Empty state renders the neutral 0 the app shows before night data exists.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: An image of a score; the centered figure and label give the value in text.

primitives.name: Sparkline
primitives.description: Catmull-Rom smoothed line with optional gradient area, highlight dot, and axis labels (@kore/ui Sparkline).
implementationHints: Plot slot takes a 24-bit SVG whose viewBox equals the rendered chart size; paths come from scalePoints + the Catmull-Rom builder in packages/ui/src/charts/buildPath.ts (pad = strokeWidth + 3).
Area fills: <path class="sparkline__area" fill="url(#spark-fill-mint|indigo|indigo-deep|peach)"> referencing the gradients the primitive defines. dot-deep state recolors the min/max dot (dotColor).

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative trend; the adjacent figure states the value.

primitives.name: Bar Chart
primitives.description: Rounded bar series with per-bar intensity color and axis labels (@kore/ui BarChart).
implementationHints: Bars: slot = width / count, bar width = slot × 0.55, min height 12%, corner radius = width / 2 (BarChart.tsx gapFraction 0.45, minBarFraction 0.12).
Activity colorFor: ≤0.18 empty track, >0.8 deep, >0.55 mid, >0.32 light, else pale.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative distribution; values are summarized in adjacent stats.

primitives.name: Hypnogram
primitives.description: Four-row sleep stage timeline with hour gridlines (@kore/ui Hypnogram).
implementationHints: Rows top→bottom: awake, REM, light, deep. y = level × (height − barHeight) / 3; bar min width 6; radius barHeight / 2; three gridlines at quarters.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative; stage totals appear in the legend.

primitives.name: Stage Bar
primitives.description: Proportional sleep-stage bar with 2pt gaps (@kore/ui StageBar).
implementationHints: Set --stage-deep/--stage-rem/--stage-light/--stage-awake to stage minutes on the use class (flex weights, order deep → REM → light → awake).

prototype.accessibilityIntent: An image of proportions; the legend lists each stage duration.

primitives.name: Heatmap Grid
primitives.description: Seven-column readiness heatmap with weekday labels (@kore/ui HeatmapGrid).
implementationHints: Cell alpha = 0.15 + v × 0.75 over mint (99,184,168); set --heat-1…--heat-7 to normalize(readiness) values (floor 0.08) on the use class. The seeded dataset covers one week, so one row renders.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: An image of relative readiness; averages appear in the stat tiles.

primitives.name: Dot Trend
primitives.description: Seven-dot temperature deviation trend over a dashed baseline (@kore/ui DotTrend).
implementationHints: Shown on the home Body Temp tile once a baseline-backed deviation exists (2+ recorded nights); dots use scalePoints with pad 6, r 3 (last r 3.5).

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Decorative trend; the value precedes it.

primitives.name: Metric Value
primitives.description: Light-weight figure with a baseline-aligned unit (@kore/ui MetricValue).
implementationHints: Hero = AnimatedNumber 44 + 13pt unit on metric detail and live HR cards.

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Plain text figure and unit.

primitives.name: Stat Block
primitives.description: Figure over a small sentence-case label (@kore/ui StatBlock).

prototype.accessibilityIntent: Plain text figure and label.
